output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # Remove the one-cell frame.  The 2 on the top frame specifies the
    # cyclic displacement: its 1-based column minus two, to the right.
    inner = [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]
    marker = next((j for j, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v == 2), 1)
    shift = (marker - 1) - 2
    w = len(inner[0])
    shift %= w
    return [r[-shift:] + r[:-shift] if shift else r[:] for r in inner]"}
